text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Elevated error rate (5xx/timeout) from inference runtime pool "inference-pool-3" for /v1/generate. Trigger: 5m error ratio > 3%. Paging eng-oncall.

sara: taking pager, on it. pinging infra and runtime leads.

mike: pulling metrics now — seeing KV store evictions spike, mem pressure on host gpu-04. 95th latency up ~2.4x. attaching quick graph in thread.

anjali: noted. any recent deploys to that pool? I see a quantization rollout to xform-lite yesterday afternoon.

leo: customer-impact check: two enterprise tenants in eu-west reported 500s and one timeout from their batch jobs. support ticket numbers attached: #SUP-1245, #SUP-1246.

sara: mitigation plan: 1) scale pool by +2 nodes (hotfix), 2) enable immediate fallback to model-small for requests that hit eviction threshold, 3) temporarily disable the quant profile on pool-3. executing step 1 now.

mike: scaling up k8s node group, also bumping kv-store max-entries for the pool. commands:
```
kubectl patch hpa inference-pool-3 --patch '{"spec":{"minReplicas":6}}'
curl -sS https://infra/api/pools/pool-3/actions/scale -XPOST -d '{"delta":2}'
```

sara: step 1 done. nodes provisioning, latency dropping at p50 but p95 still elevated.

anjali: I'm flipping the quant flag off on pool-3:
```
PATCH /api/v1/pools/pool-3/config
{"quant_profiles": []}
```

incident-bot: Action executed: quant profile disabled on pool-3 by anjali at 4765432160.

mike: after disable, eviction rate decreased ~60% and p95 improved ~30%. still seeing short-lived miss storms on specific prefixes for long-context requests.

leo: customers notified in EU — support teams sent a status update. they want an ETA for full resolution.

sara: ETA: stabilization within 30-45m, full root-cause and postmortem tomorrow. can we avoid a rollback of the whole rollout? prefer targeted fixes.

mike: agree — targeted KV pressure controls and better backpressure is lower risk than full rollback.

anjali: logging action items now. will schedule a post-incident review (PIR) for tomorrow 11:00 PT. attendees: eng-runtime, eng-infra, product-ops, support.

sara: immediate action items (owners):
- mike: add short-term guardrail to throttle incoming requests when kv-eviction > 5% (due EOD).
- anjali: add autoswitch fallback to model-small when eviction threshold tripped and log fallbacks (due tomorrow morning).
- leo: create consolidated customer impact doc and post in #support (due tonight).
- sara: write incident summary + timeline and create PIR calendar invite (done).

mike: I've added a quick metric alert to trigger earlier (eviction > 2% for 3m) and a playbook runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/internal/runbooks/kv-eviction

anjali: longer-term: (1) investigate quant packing change that increased memory footprint, (2) add KV eviction throttling at the network ingress layer, (3) test canary with larger mem headroom. I'll add these to the remediation epic.

product-ops: heads-up: we should prepare a customer-facing blurb postmortem template. I'll draft and share after PIR.

sara: ok team — monitoring looks stable. I'll keep thread open until PIR scheduled and action items tracked. great job on quick mitigation. :thumbsup:

mike: quick note — paste of the most relevant log lines:
```
[2026-03-17T16:14:02Z] inference-pool-3 kv_evict: key_prefix="conv-" evicted=122 free_mem_pct=8
[2026-03-17T16:14:05Z] inference-pool-3 request_handler: downstream_timeout id=abc123 path=/v1/generate
```

sara: thanks. last step: posting follow-up checklist in PIR agenda. tagging @product-ops and @support.

product-ops: copied, will attend. will include customer comms draft.

sara: closing pager handoff — handing to follow-up owner anjali for remediation tracking. handoff note: focus on eviction thresholds, fallback telemetry, and quant profile regression root cause.

incident-bot: Pager resolved by sara at 4765432860. Incident state: mitigated. Next step: post-incident review scheduled and remediation epic created.
